name: LinPrim Gradient Computation
definition: Computes gradients of intersection depths $\mathbf{i}$ with respect to ray space triangle corners $\mathbf{v}^{\text{ray}}$ to enable differentiable rendering of linear primitives.
summary: LinPrim Gradient Computation enables differentiable rendering by backpropagating gradients through a linear primitive rasterizer, differing from standard Gaussian Splatting by handling ray-space transformations and quaternion updates.
